item.title: Is an LLC Incorporated?
item.description: An LLC is not incorporated and it’s not the same thing as a Corporation. Having said that, however, there are similarities between LLCs and Corporations. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Can You Register an LLC Without a Social Security Number?
item.description: People often assume they will need a Social Security Number (SSN) to register an LLC with the state, but that is not necessarily true. There are identification requirements when registering a business, but an SSN is not always required.

item.title: Do I Need an EIN For a DBA?
item.description: A DBA is not a legal entity, it’s simply a name under which a business operates. For that reason, a DBA is not required to have an EIN.

item.title: Can You Run a Business Without a Registered Agent?
item.description: Formally registered business entities must designate a registered agent on their formation documents and maintain registered agent services on an ongoing basis.

item.title: Do I Really Need an LLC or Can I Remain a Sole Proprietor?
item.description: If you’ve been operating as a Sole Proprietor and are wondering if you should register your business with the state and form an LLC, the answer is a definitive yes. Here's what you need to know.

item.title: Top Signs It’s Time to Convert Your LLC to an S Corporation
item.description: There comes a time when it could very well make sense to elect S Corporation status for your LLC. Consider these signs for when it could be time to change an LLC to an S Corporation.

item.title: How to Reinstate a Business that’s Been Administratively Dissolved
item.description: Administrative dissolution occurs more often than you might think, for reasons as simple as not filing annual reports, overlooking the payment of franchise taxes, or losing and not replacing your registered agent. If it happens to your business, it’s important to act quickly to resolve the situation.
